snippet.title: Homemade Bread Without an Oven? You Need to Try This!
snippet.description:
Video: No-Oven Skillet Bread

Ingredients
160 g lukewarm milk (⅔ cup)
160 g lukewarm water (⅔ cup)
10 g sugar (1 Tbsp)
10 g dry yeast (1.5 Tbsp)
500 g flour (4 cups)
8 g salt (¾ Tbsp)
18 g oil (3 Tbsp)
Optional Topping
Butter
Chopped parsley
Pul biber (red pepper flakes)

Instructions
Preparing the Dough
In a bowl, combine the lukewarm milk and lukewarm water. (The liquids should be warm, not hot or cold.)
Add the sugar, then sprinkle the yeast on top. Let it sit for a few minutes until it becomes foamy and bubbly. This means the yeast is active.
Stir the mixture until dissolved. Add the flour and salt, and mix until a dough forms.
The dough may look slightly dry at first, but don’t worry—it will become soft as you knead it.
Add the oil and knead well until the dough is smooth and no longer sticky. The texture should be soft and elastic.

Resting the Dough
Lightly grease a bowl and place the dough inside. Brush a little oil on top to prevent drying.
Cover and let it rest in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until it doubles in size.
If you press the dough gently with your finger and it slowly springs back, it’s ready.

Shaping
Transfer the dough onto a lightly floured surface and divide it into equal portions.
Shape each portion into a smooth ball. Cover with a cloth to prevent drying.
Roll each ball out with a rolling pin into a round, flat shape.

Cooking in a Skillet
Heat a skillet over medium heat and lightly grease it with a few drops of oil.
Place the dough rounds in the skillet. When bubbles form on the surface and the bottom turns golden, flip them and cook the other side until golden and slightly crispy.

Serving
Brush the warm bread with butter. If desired, sprinkle with chopped parsley and red pepper flakes.

Skip the oven and make soft, fluffy bread right on your stovetop. This simple skillet bread recipe is my go-to for quick, delicious meals.

You do not need fancy equipment to create bakery-style results at home. This guide shows you how to prepare an easy dough recipe without a mixer and cook it in a frying pan for that perfect golden crust. It is a fantastic method for anyone who wants fresh bread without heating up the kitchen.

We walk through the entire process, from activating the yeast to achieving the right elastic texture for your homemade flatbread. Whether you are using it for a quick pizza base or serving it with butter and herbs, this no oven bread technique ensures consistent results every time. Follow these steps to master the art of pan-cooking dough.

snippet.title: You Won’t Believe This Caesar Dressing Is Homemade 🤤
snippet.description:
Homemade Caesar Salad

Caesar Dressing Ingredients

3 garlic cloves

2 anchovy fillets

1 egg yolk

1 tsp soy sauce (3 g)

2 tsp Dijon mustard (12 g)

2 tbsp lemon juice

4 tbsp olive oil (40 g)

2 tbsp yogurt

½ tsp salt

3 tbsp Parmesan cheese

Chicken Ingredients

70 g chicken fillet

2 tsp olive oil (20 g)

1 tsp paprika (3 g)

½ tsp black pepper (1 g)

1 tsp turmeric (3 g)

½ tsp salt (2 g)

Garlic Bread Ingredients

50 g soft butter

4 garlic cloves

2 tsp chopped parsley

1 loaf bread

Other Ingredients

Lettuce (as needed)

Parmesan cheese for topping

Instructions

Making the Caesar Dressing

Finely mince the garlic.

Mash the anchovy fillets and mix them with the garlic.

Add the egg yolk, soy sauce, and Dijon mustard. Whisk until the mixture becomes smooth and slightly lighter in color.

Add the lemon juice and mix well.

Slowly pour in the olive oil while whisking continuously until the dressing becomes creamy and thick.

When the dressing coats the spoon and leaves a trail, it has reached the right consistency.

Add the yogurt to make it smoother.

Finally, add salt and Parmesan cheese and mix well. The dressing is ready.

Preparing the Chicken

Slice the chicken fillet in half for even and faster cooking.

Add olive oil and coat well.

Add paprika, black pepper, turmeric, and salt. Massage the chicken to absorb the spices.

Grill in a pan over medium heat until golden on both sides and fully cooked while remaining juicy.

Making Garlic Bread

Mix softened butter with minced garlic and chopped parsley.

Slice the bread and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly on top.

Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for about 20 minutes until golden and crispy.

Assembling the Salad

Wash, dry, and chop the lettuce.

Cut the garlic bread into small pieces.

Mix part of the lettuce with some dressing, then add the rest.

Add the grilled chicken and garlic bread pieces.

Add more dressing if needed and finish with Parmesan cheese on top.

Learn to make a fresh homemade caesar salad dressing from scratch. This simple method yields a restaurant-quality flavor.

snippet.title: Why Everyone Is Obsessed With These Banana Oatmeal Cookies
snippet.description:
Video: Banana Oatmeal Cookies
Ingredients
Mashed bananas: 2 (200 g)
Butter: 115 g
White sugar: 80 g
Brown sugar: 120 g
Egg: 1
Vanilla: 1 tsp
All-purpose flour: 180 g
Rolled oats: 350 g
Baking powder: 1.5 tsp
Baking soda: 1.5 tsp
Salt: ½ tsp
Cinnamon: 1.5 tsp
Chocolate chips: 180 g

Instructions
1. Dry ingredients
Mix flour, salt, cinnamon, baking powder, and baking soda together. Set aside.

2. Wet ingredients
Make sure the butter is at room temperature. Beat it until it becomes creamy and fluffy.
Add white sugar and brown sugar, then mix again until the texture becomes light and smooth.
Add the egg and vanilla extract and mix well.

3. Add bananas
Mash the ripe bananas and add them to the mixture. Mix until fully combined and smooth.

4. Combine everything
Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and mix only until just combined.
Then add rolled oats and chocolate chips and gently fold everything together.

5. Chill the dough
Cover the bowl and refrigerate the dough for about 45 minutes.

6. Shape the cookies
Scoop dough portions (about 50 g each), roll into balls, and place them on a baking tray.
For a better look, press a few extra chocolate chips on top.

7. Bake
Preheat the oven to 180°C (356°F).
Bake for about 15 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden while the center stays soft.
Optional: turn on the top grill for the last 2–3 minutes for a more golden top.

8. Cooling
Let the cookies rest on the tray for 10 minutes before transferring them.

Result
Soft and chewy center, slightly crispy edges, with a rich banana and chocolate flavor.
